name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at the Asia range (20:00–03:00) — price only (reference)
why: Stops cluster just beyond the Asia range (20:00–03:00); aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.
